<div class="c-home-hero__text">
<h1 class="is-vishidden">APQC</h1>
<h2 class="c-home-hero__heading u-text-transform--upper u-color--white u-font--md-xl--at-large">
<strong><span>Helping organizations worldwide work smarter, faster, and with greater confidence </span>
</strong>
</h2>

<div class="u-spacing--double">
<p class="c-membership-feature__dek u-color--white u-font-weight--semi u-font--md">APQC membership provides you—and every employee in your organization—access to research-based best practices and business drivers, benchmarking tools and data, and expertise so you can discover, understand, and implement the most effective methods for process and performance improvement.</p>
